name: kokoro-speak-vs
description: Read text aloud in any editor using the open-weight Kokoro 82M TTS model.

commands.title: Kokoro Speak: Set Normalization API Key

kokoroSpeak.bufferSeconds.description: Segment size for streaming playback. 0 = stream per sentence, so audio starts as soon as the first sentence is synthesized (lowest latency). Playback stays gapless either way — segments are scheduled so each player launch's startup is hidden under the previous segment. A larger value groups more audio per segment (fewer, longer segments).

enumDescriptions: Built-in local rules + your replacements. Offline, instant, private.
An LLM applies your natural-language rules; falls back to the local rules if no backend is available.
kokoroSpeak.normalization.mode.description: How to rewrite text into a speech-friendly form before synthesis. 'ai' sends the spoken text to a model and asks once before first use.

kokoroSpeak.normalization.rules.default:
- Currency: "$10B" → "10 billion dollars"; "$3.5M" → "3.5 million dollars".
- Tilde before a number means about: "~100 events" → "about 100 events"; "~5-20%" → "about 5 to 20 percent".
- Ranges: "5-20%" → "5 to 20 percent".
- Percentages: "50%" → "50 percent".
- Arrows mean "to": "A → C" → "A to C".
- Versions: "v1.2.3" → "version 1 point 2 point 3".
- Quarters: "Q4 2025" → "fourth quarter 2025".
- Abbreviations: "e.g." → "for example"; "i.e." → "that is"; "etc." → "etcetera".
- Spell out initialism acronyms (API → A P I), but keep pronounceable names as words (NASA, OSCAR).
- Never read Markdown markers aloud: ** and * emphasis are silent (keep the word).
- Read check marks as "check": "✅" → "check". Read other emoji as a short word or drop them.
- Read code identifiers naturally (split camelCase / snake_case into words).
- Expand units and symbols, but leave ordinary numbers for the speech engine.
- Do not change meaning; only rewrite how things are spoken.
kokoroSpeak.normalization.rules.description: Natural-language normalization rules applied by 'ai' mode. Edit freely.

kokoroSpeak.normalization.replacements.description: Your own substitutions, applied in every mode (also offline). Each item is {"from":"K8s","to":"Kubernetes"} (literal) or {"pattern":"\\bWIP\\b","replacement":"work in progress","flags":"g"} (regex).

kokoroSpeak.normalization.spellOut.description: Acronyms to read letter by letter, e.g. ["API", "LFP"] → "A P I", "L F P". Applied in every mode (whole words only).

enumDescriptions: Detect a local CLI (claude → codex); else use the API key if set.
Use a local CLI agent (set 'command', e.g. claude or codex). No API key needed.
Call the Claude API directly (requires an API key — set it with 'Kokoro Speak: Set Normalization API Key').

kokoroSpeak.normalization.command.description: Explicit CLI command for backend 'cli' (e.g. 'claude' or 'codex'). Empty = auto-detect.

kokoroSpeak.normalization.timeoutMs.description: Max time for one 'ai' normalization call before falling back to the local rules. CLI agents have a cold start (~8s), so keep this generous; the API is faster.
